message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $1 050 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (2024 Q1)  
> • Redfin Data Center – “California Median Home Price” (2024)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – ACS 5‑Year Estimates (housing values)

> **Quick note:** The median price is often used as the “average” in real‑estate discussions because it’s less skewed by a few very expensive properties. The mean price is higher due to the presence of luxury homes and high‑end markets like San Francisco and Silicon Valley.
